n.quote: The final total sample consisted of 115 participants (58 male, 57 female) college students (mean age 20.31, SD 3.26; see Figure 1 ). No participants dropped out of the study before completing their session. ... A 2 (encouragement vs no-encouragement) x 2 (sex) ANOVA of partner relative ability ratings revealed a strong condition effect, F 1,71 =10.18, P <.01, partial eta squared=.13.
